title: Augmentation with Dilution? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Human Contributor Ecosystems After AI Coding Agent Adoption
abstract: arXiv:2606.26289v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI coding agents are rapidly proliferating in open-source software development, and the long-term sustainability of open-source projects is closely tied to the health of their human contributor ecosystems. Yet most existing studies treat human contributors as a static backdrop, and the available evidence on human participation after agent adoption mainly concerns newcomer outcomes. This paper takes the human contributor ecosystem as its dependent variable. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first study to estimate how agent adoption changes the number of distinct humans behind each pull request, and to relate this change to agent pull requests recorded under developer accounts. Using the AIDev dataset, GitHub API scanning, agent-trace screening, and two-stage propensity score matching, we construct a balanced panel of 2,246 treated and 3,798 control repositories from January 2023 to May 2026, and estimate effects with the Sun-Ab

translated_title: 增强伴随稀释？AI编程智能体采用后人类贡献者生态系统的大规模实证研究
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体正在开源软件开发中迅速普及，而开源项目的长期可持续性与其人类贡献者生态的健康状况密切相关。然而，现有大多数研究将人类贡献者视为静态背景，且关于智能体采用后人类参与的现有证据主要集中在新手成果方面。本文将人类贡献者生态系统本身作为因变量。据我们所知，这是首个估计智能体采用如何改变每个拉取请求背后不同人类数量，并将这一变化与记录在开发者账户下的智能体拉取请求相关联的研究。利用AIDev数据集、GitHub API扫描、智能体轨迹筛选以及两阶段倾向得分匹配，我们构建了2023年1月至2026年5月期间包含2,246个处理仓库和3,798个对照仓库的平衡面板数据，并采用Sun-Abraham估计方法来估计效应……
tldr: 该论文首次将开源项目的人类贡献者生态系统作为研究对象，通过大规模面板数据和倾向得分匹配，实证估计AI编程智能体的采用如何改变每个拉取请求背后的人类贡献者数量，揭示了智能体“增强”可能伴随人类贡献“稀释”的现象。
en_tdlr: This is the first large-scale empirical study to treat the human contributor ecosystem as the outcome, estimating how AI coding agent adoption changes the number of distinct humans behind each pull request, revealing that agent-driven augmentation may come with a dilution of human contribution.
